summary: Phase 2 SEO on-page (iter299) frontend verification — all 19 review-request assertions PASS. Breadcrumbs render correctly on /shop, /shop?category=Wall+Art, /shop/wood-steel-console-table, /makers, /makers/iron-and-oak. Canonical URLs are exactly one per route and point to the correct craftersmarket.org slug. Titles match the requested format. JSON-LD @graph carries Product+BreadcrumbList (PDP), Organization+BreadcrumbList (MakerDetail), CollectionPage+BreadcrumbList (MakersPage). Canonical-leak regression also fixed — after a PDP visit, returning to / restores canonical to https://craftersmarket.org/.

critical_code_review_comments: Console (unrelated to this task): React warning 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority?' — should be fetchPriority (camelCase) in JSX wherever it is used. Low priority but noisy in DevTools.

Pre-existing harmless duplicate '@type:BreadcrumbList' in @graph on /shop pages (one from the static site-wide JSON-LD in index.html, one from useStructuredData) — Google tolerates this but consider deduping in a later pass.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter299 Phase 2 SEO breadcrumb/canonical/JSON-LD work confirmed in the SPA. seo.js setLink() now correctly updates the static <link rel=canonical> in place rather than appending — verified by visiting PDP then returning to / and seeing canonical revert to craftersmarket.org/. All four pages (ShopPage, MakersPage, ProductDetail, MakerDetail) emit BreadcrumbList JSON-LD and visible nav. /shop?category=Wall+Art encodes the space as %20 in the canonical, which is correct per RFC 3986 and equivalent to '+' for query strings; Google treats them identically. No retest needed.
